purpose: Screen a minimal symmetric family of deterministic Hiku/Jiagu ordinal-rank fusions on the untouched E290-E299 cohort for E2 homogeneous n100 low, then require an independently preregistered E300-E319 n20 confirmation before any provisional or final closure.

design_boundary.vote_family_definition: The complete minimal positive symmetric integer neighborhood for two experts: 1:1, 2:1, and 1:2, plus the pre-existing Hiku-primary/Jiagu-final-tie profile as a non-Borda control.

screen_matrix.pre_registration_boundary: Before this plan was written, E290-E319 did not occur in any manifest, tape, reference, run, summary, quarantine, pairing report, or result artifact in this repository.

candidates.definition: Scale-free ordinal Borda sum of load-faithful Hiku and current-demand Jiagu.
Fixed Hiku-majority ordinal Borda with no state router or learned coefficient.
Fixed Jiagu-majority ordinal Borda with no state router or learned coefficient.
Pre-existing load-faithful Hiku ordering with Jiagu used only after all Hiku keys tie.

reference_policy.reason: Online expert profiles produce policy-specific state trajectories even though reference values conditional on a state remain policy-independent.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan before expanding or capturing E290-E299.
Generate exactly four candidate manifests with ten E2 homogeneous n100-low NSESche run specs each.
Capture ten base tapes once, derive ten scale5 tapes, and bind identical tape hashes across candidates without reading performance.
Build forty candidate-specific trajectory-matched references; require attempt one and zero quarantine before online execution.

Run all forty NSESche processes strictly serially in candidate order and seed order; require attempt one, zero quarantine, exact coverage, ledger, QC, pairing, reference, tape, and runtime-identity gates.
Only after the complete forty-run joint result-blind audit passes may throughput or QPR be read once for all candidates.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean of fixed_observation_window throughput in requests/ms across all ten seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Per-run fixed-window throughput divided by mean completed-request latency and simulator cost per completed request, then arithmetic mean across finite runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with zero-completion runs contributing zero, divided by all ten seeds.
analysis.candidate_gate: A candidate must strictly exceed all three frozen thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.selection_rule: Among candidates passing all three metrics, maximize the minimum relative margin over the three thresholds; break exact ties by the listed candidate order.
analysis.success_action: Freeze exactly one selected profile and preregister a fresh E300-E319 n20 confirmation before generating those seeds.
analysis.failure_action: Retain all E290-E299 evidence, report every failed metric, and do not retune or rerun on E270-E299.
